title: Enough
coreMove: Define enough before desire, status, or comparison starts bargaining; then ambition can serve a good life instead of turning each gain into a new lack.

exampleSpecs.audience: operators tempted to add one more run after a good day
exampleSpecs.stakes: a finished day can be rewritten by comparison unless the boundary stays visible
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after the day ends, the evidence shows that the enough list protected the chosen boundary

exampleSpecs.audience: people who notice a target changing after it was met
exampleSpecs.stakes: the badge can turn useful movement into being ruled by wanting
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices her own error mid-action and gives desire a limit

exampleSpecs.audience: workers whose financial targets move after rankings appear
exampleSpecs.stakes: a clear written line can hold against status pressure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the written artifact carries the action by naming an enough list before comparison arrives

exampleSpecs.audience: clerks who treat one more file as relief from wanting
exampleSpecs.stakes: two workers face the same queue and split on whether desire gets a limit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two named people take opposite approaches at the same records window, with different outcomes

exampleSpecs.audience: people who let a scoreboard move the target
exampleSpecs.stakes: a peer reframes the score before comparison steals the night
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a mentor gives one quotable reframe that restores the enough list

exampleSpecs.audience: learners confused by need versus comparison
exampleSpecs.stakes: the supply count can teach sufficiency before wanting more becomes the default
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the learner's confusion becomes the material for teaching sufficiency
